note: How to use the Meeting Builder and bring something to the meeting. Voiced Andrew Expressive +0% on the tts-run runner. Line 1 re-voiced undated (key mtusefix) so the film outlives one Friday.

scenes.say: Every week, this branch meets. Here is how to bring something to it.
Go to Ricky Rampersad branch dot com, slash meetings. Type your agent number. Nothing else to remember.
Your day opens with a short list. Read the agenda, then press: put my item on the agenda.
Pick the item you want to talk about. Under it is the question to answer.
Then say what you are bringing. A commitment, a concern, something that works, or a question.
Press the button, and it is on the agenda before anybody sits down.
It does not mark you present. That is a different tap.
Everybody sees what the branch brought, grouped by what it is, by item, or by person.
At half past eleven, press the button that says I am here. That one is the register.
